# Abul Khair Tobacco Co. Ltd. (AKTCL)

> Abul Khair Tobacco Co. Ltd. (AKTCL), part of Abul Khair Group, Bangladesh, is a vertically integrated tobacco company — "From Seed to Smoke". It exports leaf tobacco, processed tobacco (CUTRAG, CRES, DIET, STEM, SCRAP, RE-CON) and finished cigarettes, including OEM and private label manufacturing. This is a business-to-business website for tobacco trade professionals of legal age. It is not directed at consumers and does not sell tobacco products to the public.

WARNING: Tobacco products are harmful to health and are addictive.

## Company
- About: https://www.aktcl.com/about-us
  AKTCL has been shaping Bangladesh's tobacco industry since 1953, beginning with traditional biri before expanding into filtered cigarette manufacturing in 1997. It is the largest local tobacco company in Bangladesh, with a network of 50,000+ registered farmers, Green Leaf Threshing (GLT) and cigarette manufacturing facilities.
- Country of origin: Bangladesh
- Parent: Abul Khair Group — https://www.abulkhairgroup.com/

## Products
- Overview: https://www.aktcl.com/products

### Leaf Tobacco — https://www.aktcl.com/products/leaf-tobacco
Premium tobacco cultivated, cured, processed, and graded to meet the diverse requirements of manufacturers around the world.
- **Virginia Flue-Cured (FCV)** — https://www.aktcl.com/products/leaf-tobacco/virginia-flue-cured
- **Burley Tobacco** — https://www.aktcl.com/products/leaf-tobacco/burley
- **CUTRAG Tobacco** — https://www.aktcl.com/products/leaf-tobacco/cutrag
  Precision-cut tobacco with controlled cut width and consistency.
- **CRES** — https://www.aktcl.com/products/leaf-tobacco/cres
  Cut, rolled and expanded tobacco stem.
- **DIET** — https://www.aktcl.com/products/leaf-tobacco/diet
  Dry Ice Expanded Tobacco.
- **STEM** — https://www.aktcl.com/products/leaf-tobacco/stem
  Tobacco raw material derived from the central veins and stems of tobacco leaves.
- **SCRAP** — https://www.aktcl.com/products/leaf-tobacco/scrap
- **RE-CON** — https://www.aktcl.com/products/leaf-tobacco/recon
  Reconstituted tobacco sheet.

### Finished Cigarettes — https://www.aktcl.com/products/finished-cigarettes
Manufactured for AKTCL's own brands, OEM customers and private label partners.
Formats: King Size Filter, Super Slim, NANO, Private Label Manufacturing, AKT Signature Collection.
- **AKT Signature Collection** — https://www.aktcl.com/products/finished-cigarettes/akt-signature-collection
  Flagship premium cigarette portfolio representing AKT's highest manufacturing standards.

Specifications are available on request through the enquiry form.
